question: After the merged Web UI session-thread work, should #54397 remain the broad umbrella for the remaining CLI/TUI metadata and import/export scope, or should maintainers split those residual pieces into narrower canonical issues?
rationale: Current main solves a large visible slice, but the issue still requests broader product semantics that cross storage, protocol, UI, TUI, and CLI boundaries and should not be chosen by repair automation.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split follow-ups
options.body: Keep #54397 open as the product umbrella while linking narrower accepted issues for CLI lifecycle, richer metadata, import/export behavior, and topic-family design.

options.title: Replace with narrower canonical issues
options.body: Close #54397 only after creating and linking focused replacement issues that fully preserve the remaining accepted scope.

options.title: Declare current scope enough
options.body: Treat the merged Web UI/sidebar/picker thread management as sufficient and explicitly defer or reject the broader CLI/TUI/import-export asks.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split follow-ups
recommendation.body: Keep #54397 open as the product umbrella while linking narrower accepted issues for CLI lifecycle, richer metadata, import/export behavior, and topic-family design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged session-thread management and grouping work make this the closest current owner for deciding the remaining session-management product boundary.
